svg.title: Orchestration of Craving, Clinging, Relishing, Intention, Obsessions, Biases, Measurement, and Objectification

g.text: Orchestration of Craving, Clinging, Relishing, Intention, Obsessions, Biases, Measurement, and Objectification
The Process of Dependent Co-arising: From Contact to Becoming
Contact is the requisite condition for feeling, perception, and kamma to come into play.
Relishing is a key characteristic of craving, fostering its development.
(Deep-seated latent tendencies, e.g., passion, resistance, ignorance, which become "obsessed" when relished);
(Mental proliferation, conceptual complication; mind elaborates on experiences);
Cessation of contact leads to the cessation of objectification.
"I am" is termed a "wavering" and "objectification" [from previous conversation].
(The "I-making or mine-making conceit-obsession;" identifying with phenomena as "mine," "my self," "what I am");
(Is kamma; "what one intends, what one arranges, and what one obsesses about" is a support for consciousness)
(Tendencies to "go off course" through desire, aversion, delusion, and fear, leading to unskillful actions);
(Unskillful actions caused by biases and defilements);
Actions performed with greed, aversion, or delusion ripen and lead to future becoming.
Craving is the "moisture" for consciousness, the "seed" of renewed becoming.
(Desire and passion for the five clinging-aggregates, considered the "burden")
Continually focusing on the allure of "clingable phenomena" (the aggregates) causes craving to grow and sustains the process.
Consciousness (as a seed for renewed becoming)
(Supported by intention and obsession; "lands and grows" due to passion, delight, craving)
The convergence of clinging, consciousness (as a seed), and intention leads to the production of renewed becoming.
(Production of renewed existence; sensual, form, and formless becoming)
Birth, Aging, Death, Sorrow, Lamentation, Pain, Distress, Despair
(The entire mass of stress and suffering)
